split_unit: Whole scene/family; family A train, B validation, C test; no frame/counterfactual splits
test_use: Automated integrity/label QA only; no model evaluation, tuning or preview
static_frame_selection: Fixed midpoint index2, one frame per scene; repeated static frames excluded from learning export
moving_frame_selection: All five synchronized 1Hz frames, episode stays in one split
classification_source: Rendered pixel ownership only, not learned detector or simulator-nearest-center heuristic
proposal_source: Unfiltered geometry baseline to include rejected curved objects; full depth provided for alternate proposal methods
training_status: Perception development pilot only; no model trained/validated and no World Model training eligibility
dataset_limits: One warehouse and one human mesh, multiple poses/animation phases; not real-world or cross-simulator validation
Scripted diagnostic motion, not native social policy behavior
Camera keeps original low calibration; visibility fraction is in-view silhouette, not whole body
Dataset size is a pilot, not a complete training corpus
